common_faqs.q: What is the PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi scheme?
common_faqs.a: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. It provides an income support of 6,000/- per year in three equal installments to all land holding farmer families.

common_faqs.q: Who is eligible for the scheme?
common_faqs.a: The scheme is for land holding farmer families. The definition of family for the scheme is husband, wife and minor children.

common_faqs.q: How can I register for the scheme?
common_faqs.a: You can register for the scheme by visiting the PM-Kisan website and filling out the registration form.

common_faqs.q: How can I check my eligibility status?
common_faqs.a: You can check your eligibility status on the PM-Kisan website or mobile app or by contacting the Kisan eMitra chatbot.

common_faqs.q: What is the exclusion criteria for the scheme?
common_faqs.a: The exclusion criteria for the scheme includes beneficiaries of higher economic status, institutional land holders, farmer families which belong to one or more of the following, farmer families which acquired land ownership after 01-02-2019, and cases where more than one family member is receiving benefits.

application_steps: Apply to the states and union territories for the interventions, follow the guidelines and procedures for approval and implementation of annual plans, and submit the reports as per the reporting system.

common_faqs.q: What is the objective of the National Food Security and Nutrition Mission?
common_faqs.a: To increase the production and productivity of Shree Anna/Millets, Rice, Wheat, Coarse Cereals (Maize and Barley), and Commercial Crops (Jute and Sugarcane) through area expansion and productivity enhancement.

common_faqs.q: What are the major interventions of the National Food Security and Nutrition Mission?
common_faqs.a: Demonstrations on improved crop production and crop protection technologies, distribution of certified seeds of notified varieties, production of certified seeds of Shree Anna (Nutri-Cereals), integrated nutrient management (INM) and integrated pest management (IPM) interventions, cropping system-based demonstrations for enhancing productivity and sustainability, and capacity building of farmers through cropping system-based training programmes.

common_faqs.q: What are the area of operation of the National Food Security and Nutrition Mission?
common_faqs.a: The National Food Security and Nutrition Mission is being implemented in 28 States and 2 Union Territories (Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh).
